waivers.reason: Hybrid retriever v1 drops this case's recall to 0.5 (one of two gold chunks ranks outside k=5); this is the documented 1.0000-to-0.95 aggregate recall delta of RAG-009's completion notes, accepted at baseline so the release gate measures what the hybrid ships, not a new regression. Any candidate that changes the manifest must fix it or re-argue the waiver. Manifest hashes were refreshed when the query planner version joined the manifest and again when lead confirmation raised the dispatcher graph to dispatch@3. The manifest hashes were refreshed again when the failed-attribution release raised the dispatcher graph to dispatch@4, and that re-mint picked up the stricter corpus digest (R-15), which now covers each chunk's text and active flag; the corpus fixtures are byte-identical to what the baseline review saw, and from now on any text or active-flag edit changes the digest and voids these bindings. The hashes were refreshed again when the routing-funnel release (review 2026-08-28, N-02) raised the routing policy to intent-routing@2: the retriever, corpus, thresholds, and fixtures are unchanged, so the waived regressions are the same two the baseline review saw.
